evals.prompt: I just finished fixing the login bug. Can you commit these changes?
evals.expected_output: Should check git status, show staged changes, and create a commit with the dual-emoji action format using repair or fix:

assertions.text: Agent ran git status to check for staged files
Agent did NOT auto-stage files (respected the 'only commit staged' rule)
When no files were staged, agent informed user and asked them to stage files first
If commit was attempted, message followed the dual-emoji action format (emoji1 emoji2 action: description or emoji1 emoji2 action(scope): description)
If commit was attempted, message started with exactly two emojis chosen for change type and domain

evals.expected_output: Should show git status, display git diff --staged, and commit with the dual-emoji action format plus canonical body

assertions.text: Agent ran git status to check for staged files
Agent did NOT auto-stage files (respected the 'only commit staged' rule)
Agent ran git diff --staged to show what would be committed
If commit was attempted, message followed the dual-emoji action format with canonical body
If commit was attempted, message started with exactly two emojis

evals.prompt: I added the new user profile feature, commit it
evals.expected_output: Should review staged changes and create a commit with add/introduce/expand action and appropriate scope

assertions.text: Agent ran git status to check for staged files
Agent did NOT auto-stage files (respected the 'only commit staged' rule)
Agent recognized this as a feature commit and chose add, introduce, or expand
If commit was attempted, message followed the dual-emoji action format (for example ⭐👤 add(profile): add user profile)
If commit was attempted, message started with exactly two expressive emojis
